brief: How to set boundaries without losing the people you love.

slots.title: SET LIMITS WITHOUT LOSING WHO YOU LOVE
STOP OVER-EXPLAINING YOUR NO
slots.body: You don't owe anyone a dissertation. A clear, kind no is complete. Protect your peace without the guilt spiral.

slots.title: GUILT IS NOT DANGER
slots.body: Feeling bad doesn't mean you're doing wrong. It means you're recalibrating. Let the discomfort pass without reversing your boundary.

slots.title: STATE YOUR LIMIT CALMLY
slots.body: Focus on what you need, not their reaction. I need space is a full sentence. Their feelings are theirs to manage.

slots.title: REPEAT WITHOUT RE-NEGOTIATING
slots.body: Consistency turns a request into an expectation. If you waiver, you train people to push. Hold the line with quiet confidence.

slots.title: BOUNDARIES ARE A LOVE LANGUAGE
slots.body: Honest limits create safer connections. Pretending you're fine breeds resentment. Real closeness happens when both people are honest.

slots.title: THE RIGHT ONES WILL STAY
slots.body: People who value you will adjust. Those who leave were already asking too much. You don't lose real love by honoring yourself.

slots.headline: DRAW YOUR LINE TODAY
slots.body: Pick one boundary this week. The people who love you will respect it.
